The plate is a square plate, roughly 22-24 cm across. The peeled banana is cut into two pieces. The longer piece is about 12 cm and the shorter piece about 8 cm, and the diameter is about 3.5 cm. Together that is roughly 20 cm of banana. A full peeled banana of about 18-20 cm weighs around 100-120 g, so this is about 105 g.
